$comment: Dataset manifest. Grows as the builder reads more settings from it. Command-line options override these values.
name: Core 3
summary: The Cast at the main campus, plus generated households at two more campuses. About half of the new households have photos.
bestFor: Building and trying campus features, such as campus filters, reports, and check-in.
highlights: Three campuses, each with its own people
The full Cast at the main campus
Scanned images of every check gift

checkImages.$comment: Every check gets images; Core 3 is still small.

generatedHouseholds.$comment: Companion households. The Cast fills the main campus, so it gets none. statusWeights makes them more involved than the Crowd (decision 142).

giving.$comment: Small datasets scale up the check weight so check batches and check images have enough to show (decision 143). Full 7 keeps the measured mix.

photos.$comment: About half of the companion households get faces from the 120-photo pool (decision 30).
